in_sanskrit.name: तरकेश्वर
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who delivers or saves from (तर्क) the lord (ईश्वर)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who delivers or saves from troubles, difficulties, or negative influences, through the grace and power of the lord.

in_hindi.name: Tarkeshwar
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Crossroads
in_hindi.long_meaning: Tarkeshwar एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Tarkeshwar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Tarka’ meaning Crossroads and ‘Ishwar’ meaning God or Lord. The name Tarkeshwar signifies the one who is the Lord of the Crossroads, and is considered to be a powerful and strong deity in Hindu mythology.
